integrity: The novel comparison concerns the three Chang graph cases. The classical triangular-graph value is included as an explicitly known comparator; no unsupported complete homotopy classification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the four strongly regular graphs with parameters (28,12,6,4) are covered.
Integral second homology is determined, while the full integral first homology and full homotopy types are not claimed.
The eight-cycle and three-plus-five Chang graphs have the same second homology rank; graph isomorphism does not follow.
The finite exhaustive computation is supplied as a reproducible exact checker; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Integral Second Homology of the Chang and Triangular Graph Independence Complexes
